messages:
Maria V: Heads up — noticed a bunch of console dashboards started throwing errors after the compact telemetry write went live. queries that expect route_attrs as a single text column fail with 'column route_attrs does not exist'. stack trace attached.
Maria V: Example error: `ERROR: column analytics.events.route_attrs does not exist at character 245` — came from dashboard query for per-route p99 latency.
Aj Chen: Ugh. Was the read-adapter enabled? I thought we had a shim for route_attrs -> route_attrs_v2 mapping.
Maria V: Read-adapter PR merged but not rolled all the way. For some queries it's falling through. Quick workaround idea: add a compatibility selector in SQL:
Maria V: ```sql
-- read adapter fallback
SELECT
  COALESCE(route_attrs_v2->>'display_name', route_attrs_v1) AS route_name,
  count(*)
FROM analytics.events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY 1;
```
Taylor: Dashboards do a lot of string ops on route_name (grouping/ordering). We should avoid changing semantics. Maybe add a route_id->route_alias mapping table so old queries can join.
Samir: Proposed rollout: canary dualwrite + read-adapter on 5% tenants, watch error rate and key dashboards. If stable 48h, expand. Backfill should be run as a rate-limited job (50rps) to avoid query pressure.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: schema-read-adapter v0.3 -> 5% tenants. Triggered by @Samir. Canaries: tenant-123, tenant-7, tenant-19.
Aj Chen: For backfill do idempotent upserts keyed by route_id and use updated_at check. Example:
Aj Chen: ```sql
INSERT INTO analytics.route_attrs_v2 (route_id, attr_map, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, now())
ON CONFLICT (route_id) DO UPDATE
  SET attr_map = EXCLUDED.attr_map, updated_at = EXCLUDED.updated_at
  WHERE analytics.route_attrs_v2.updated_at < EXCLUDED.updated_at;
```
Maria V: Also add a UI fallback in the Console: when route_name missing, show alias from mapping table and add a small banner 'compat mode'. We'll gate that behind a feature flag so dashboards don't break for customers.
Taylor: I'll patch the dashboard queries that do `LIKE`/`substring()` to use `route_attrs_v2->>'display_name'` when feature flag on. Will add automated tests that run against the read-adapter locally.
Samir: Monitoring plan: create two alerts — one on `console.query.errors` (count / total_queries > 0.5%) and one on `console.latency.p95` regression > 20% compared to baseline. Also add a synthetic dashboard smoke test hitting the top-5 queries every 10m.
Maria V: Backfill schedule: start at 2026-04-01T15:00:00Z, dualwrite for 48h, backfill ramp 10 -> 50 rps over 6 hours. Owners: @Aj Chen (backfill job), @Taylor (dashboards + UI flag), @Samir (canary + monitoring). PR: https://git.internal/r/console/telemetry/compaction-compat
Aj Chen: One more: quota routing needs a small adjust — old quota windows group by route_name, new system uses route_id. We'll add a mapping join in the quota calc path to preserve quota buckets during canary.
Samir: Quick alert query for the error rate (Datadog style): `sum:console.query.errors{env:prod,tenant:canary}/sum:console.query.total{env:prod,tenant:canary} > 0.005`
Maria V: OK let's run the canary, monitor for 12h hard, escalate if any dashboard error > 0 in that time. If we get noisy false positives because of old saved queries, we'll flip the UI compat flag off and revert read-adapter on prod.
Taylor: I'll also add migration notes to the ops runbook and a short list of saved queries that need manual edits.
Samir: I'll wire the synthetic smoke job and post graphs in #incidents if any red flags. Running a short pre-check now against staging queries.
Maria V: Thanks — queued the canary start and added the rollout checklist to the PR. Will post updates here. :thumbsup:
Aj Chen: :+1:
Taylor: LGTM :shipit:
Samir: :raising_hand: starting monitoring playbook now.
